ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AD$ and $BE$ are the altitude and angle bisector of $\triangle ABC$, respectively, with $\angle BAC=86^\circ$ and $\angle C=58^\circ$. Find the measure of $\angle AOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\angle BAC=86^\circ$, $\angle C=58^\circ$\\
Therefore, $\angle ABC=180^\circ-86^\circ-58^\circ=36^\circ$\\
Since $AD$ and $BE$ are the altitude and angle bisector of $\triangle ABC$ respectively,\\
Therefore, $\angle OBD=\frac{1}{2}\angle ABC=18^\circ$, $\angle ADB=90^\circ$\\
Hence, $\angle AOB=\angle OBD+\angle ADB=18^\circ+90^\circ=\boxed{108^\circ}$
